_note: Excursions and shared experiences during the Youth Strategic Forum, Dubai 2026, sourced from the CSCD marketing site's Agenda section. Dubai's programme is modules-based rather than built around named institutional visits, so this list covers the forum's two shared excursions instead of embassy/ministry visits like Jakarta's.

visits.name: Dubai Marina Cruise Dinner
visits.description: An evening on the water at Dubai Marina dedicated to breaking the ice and building cross-cultural understanding among delegates.

visits.name: Desert Safari
visits.description: A dune drive into the Dubai desert with a cultural camp and dinner under the stars.
highlights: Dune drive into the Dubai desert
